In this part of this question, we will look at emotion ratings of images for a psychology experiment. Each row of the DataFrame F represents an image, and each column represents an emotion. There are $$940$$ images and $$7$$ emotions. An example row of F, for the image img1, has the following values:
• Happy: $$2$$
• Sad: $$2$$
• Afraid: $$2$$
• Anger: $$3$$
• Disgusted: $$4$$
• Surprised: $$2$$
• Neutral: $$6$$
Say we perform the SVD on F using the following code:
X $$=$$ (F - np.mean(F, axis $$=$$ 0))
u, s, vt $$=$$ np.linalg.svd(X, $$	exttt{full\_matrices=False)}$$
